subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete sentence.
stimulus: There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. Column A Column B a. The addicts feel i. enforced immediately. b. When someone finds no hope left ii. intensive pain in the body. c. The frequent taking of drug iii. to arrange money. d. They have to commit crimes iv. lead a man to death. e. The law must be v. he addicts to drug. vi. peace and happiness in mind. vii. huge amount of money.
guide_solution: (a + ii) : The addicts feel intensive pain in the body. (b + v) : When someone finds no hope left he addicts to drug. (c + iv) : The frequent taking of drug lead a man to death. (d + iii) : They have to commit crimes to arrange money. (e + i) : The law must be enforced immediately.
